sun.security.util.math

接口 MutableIntegerModuloP

  • 所有超级接口:
    IntegerModuloP
    所有已知实现类:
    IntegerPolynomial.MutableElement

    public interface MutableIntegerModuloP
extends IntegerModuloP
    An interface for mutable integers modulo a prime value. This interface should be used to improve performance and avoid the allocation of a large number of temporary objects. Methods in this interface that modify the value also return the modified element. This structure enables fluent expressions like: a.setSum(b).setProduct(c).setDifference(d).setSquare()

    • 方法详细资料

      • conditionalSet

        void conditionalSet(IntegerModuloP b,
                    int set)
        Set this value to the value of b when set has the value 1. No change is made to this element when set has the value 0. The result is undefined when set has a value other than 0 or 1. The set parameter is an int (rather than boolean) to allow the implementation to perform the assignment using branch-free integer arithmetic.
        参数:
        b - the element to conditionally swap with
        set - an int that determines whether to set

      • conditionalSwapWith

        void conditionalSwapWith(MutableIntegerModuloP b,
                         int swap)
        Swap the value of this with the value of b when swap has the value 1. No change is made to either element when swap has the value 0. The result is undefined when swap has a value other than 0 or 1. The swap parameter is an int (rather than boolean) to allow the implementation to perform the swap using branch-free integer arithmetic.
        参数:
        b - the element to conditionally swap with
        swap - an int that determines whether to swap

      • setValue

        MutableIntegerModuloP setValue(byte[] v,
                               int offset,
                               int length,
                               byte highByte)
        Set the value equal to the little-endian unsigned integer stored at the specified position in an array. The range of accepted values is implementation-specific. This method also takes a byte which is interpreted as an additional high-order byte of the number.
        参数:
        v - an array containing a little-endian unsigned integer
        offset - the starting position of the integer
        length - the number of bytes to read
        highByte - the high-order byte of the number
        返回:
        this
